tfmg.jei.info.blast_furnace.1: Shape: a hollow tower of 3x3 layers, 3 to 10 layers high. On each layer the 4 edge blocks are Fireproof Bricks and the 4 corners are Fireproof Brick Reinforcements. The centre stays empty, except on the bottom layer where it must be a Fireproof Brick.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_furnace.2: The Blast Furnace Output replaces one bottom edge brick and faces outward. Molten metal and slag are pumped out of it.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_furnace.3: Feed: ore (crushed iron, raw iron), Limesand as flux and Coal Coke Dust as fuel. Drop them into the top of the shaft or insert them into the Output with a funnel. Only ore a recipe can smelt is accepted.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_furnace.4: Hot air: place one Blast Furnace Hatch in a wall and pipe Hot Air into it. A second wall hatch cuts the tower at that height. A hatch at the top centre collects the furnace gas.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_furnace.5: A taller furnace is faster. Building it entirely from reinforced blocks (Reinforced Fireproof Bricks and Blast Furnace Reinforcements) doubles its speed.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_furnace.6: Goggles show height, fuel and time left. Below 3 layers the furnace does nothing.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_stove.1: Turns Air plus Furnace Gas or Creosote into Hot Air for the blast furnace, with CO2 as a by-product.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_stove.2: Up to 2x2 wide and as tall as you like. A bigger stove works faster: one steel furnace needs about a 2x2 stove 5 blocks high.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_stove.3: Sides of the bottom layer: Air in, CO2 out. Top and bottom faces: fuel in, Hot Air out.
tfmg.jei.info.blast_stove.4: Pump the CO2 away (Exhaust or Smokestack), otherwise the stove stops when its CO2 tank is full. Pipe Air into the bottom sides and fuel into the top or bottom; each input tank refuses any other fluid.
tfmg.jei.info.air_intake.1: Makes Air from rotation. Works alone or as a 2x2 or 3x3 square of intakes facing the same way.
tfmg.jei.info.air_intake.2: Output grows with speed and with the square of the size. A single intake needs at least 40 RPM.
tfmg.jei.info.coke_oven.1: One Coke Oven works alone. To make it bigger, build an N x N square of ovens facing the same way that rises up and goes backwards from the bottom front block (one block wide, up to 6 x 6). From 3 x 3 on it cokes faster; a 2 x 2 is no faster than one block.
tfmg.jei.info.coke_oven.2: Insert coal; Coal Coke drops out in front of the oven.
tfmg.jei.info.coke_oven.3: Creosote comes out of any side, CO2 only out of the TOP face.
tfmg.jei.info.coke_oven.4: If either tank fills up the oven pauses, so keep both pumped out.
tfmg.jei.info.casting_basin.1: Pour molten metal in: 144 mB casts one ingot.
tfmg.jei.info.casting_basin.2: Take the ingot with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel or hopper.
tfmg.jei.info.arc_furnace.1: The arc furnace is a Firebrick-lined Chemical Vat of at least 3x3 (9 blocks).
tfmg.jei.info.arc_furnace.2: It needs 3 Electrode Holders on top of the vat, each holding a Graphite Electrode and powered from its top face.
tfmg.jei.info.arc_furnace.3: A graphite electrode needs at least 1500 V to work. Use a Large Generator or a transformer.
tfmg.jei.info.arc_furnace.4: Coal Coke Dust acts as a catalyst: it goes back into the vat input, and only about 10% is used up per batch.
tfmg.jei.info.vat.1: Chemical Vats form multiblocks up to 3x3 wide. Recipes can ask for a minimum size, a vat type, heat, pressure and machines.
tfmg.jei.info.vat.2: Machines go on top or around the vat: Industrial Mixer, Electrode Holders, Compressor, Freezer. Every attached machine must be working, or no recipe runs.
tfmg.jei.info.vat.3: Heat comes from Fireboxes or Blaze Burners under the vat. Pipes can only fill the inputs and drain the outputs.
tfmg.jei.info.distillation.1: Put the Distillation Controller on the side of a Steel Fluid Tank and stack Distillation Outputs above it, with an Industrial Pipe between each output.
tfmg.jei.info.distillation.2: The number of outputs must equal the number of products of the recipe.
tfmg.jei.info.distillation.3: The tank must be at least twice as tall as the number of outputs, and 2 wide when there are more than 3 outputs.
tfmg.jei.info.distillation.4: Heat it with Fireboxes or Blaze Burners under the tank: more heat, faster distillation.
tfmg.jei.info.firebox.1: Burns fuel fluids (LPG, butane, propane, hydrogen, diesel, kerosene, naphtha) to heat what sits on top.
tfmg.jei.info.firebox.2: It makes CO2: pump it away, or the firebox stops when its exhaust is full.
tfmg.jei.info.surface_scanner.1: Finds oil deposits in the surrounding chunks.
tfmg.jei.info.surface_scanner.2: Needs a Machine Input directly below it, turning at 64 RPM or more.
tfmg.jei.info.large_generator.1: A Rotor surrounded by a ring of 8 Stators. Without all 8 it generates nothing.
tfmg.jei.info.large_generator.2: It produces far more voltage than the small generator, enough for the arc furnace.
tfmg.jei.info.coal_coke_dust.1: The only fuel of the blast furnace. Crush Coal Coke to get it.
tfmg.jei.info.coal_coke_dust.2: Also the catalyst of the arc furnace, where it mostly comes back after each batch.
